title: feat: build the E2B templates from CI
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added a GitHub Actions workflow that rebuilds the `pollinations` and `pollinations-large` E2B templates when E2B files or the workflow change on the `production` branch; it also supports manual runs. The builds retain the existing commands and sizes, including a 50 GiB disk for `pollinations-large`. Pinned `e2bdev/base` to a digest so base-image changes require a PR. The Dockerfile now points to the workflow, while the manual `pollinations-test` steps remain available for testing changes. The build was tested without an interactive terminal, and actionlint passed.
